protocol.source: pinned epoch100 compact E4 export from independent E2 scale freeze-after50 run
protocol.mantissa_bit_names: m2=magnitude 1/2, m1=1/4, m0=1/8 for normal E2M3 elements
protocol.lsb_trunc: retain sign, exponent field E, and m2; delete m1,m0
protocol.rne: nearest E2M1 value to the SAME E2M3 code, ties to even, saturating
protocol.msb_bestexp: retain sign and m0, choose Eprime in 0..3 to minimize absolute source error
protocol.msb_ties: minimize abs(Eprime-E), then choose smallest Eprime
protocol.optimization_scope: smallest per-element source error under fixed m0; NOT accuracy optimality
protocol.shared_scales: copy existing E2 E8M0 bytes unchanged for all three E2M1 alternatives
protocol.bn_policy: same saved bank4, fixed evaluation mode for every E2M1 alternative; no recalibration
protocol.other_modes: E4 and E2M3 are loaded as unchanged controls
protocol.dataset: full SVHN official test, no train or extra loading
protocol.error_reference: decoded E2M3 source, not unavailable FP32 master
protocol.numerical_population: uniform code patterns with scale1, not observed weights
protocol.accuracy_population: actual 26032 SVHN test images; only populated after evaluate
protocol.hardware_claim: bit operations described; no measured area, latency or energy
limitations: Parent weights and BN were trained with LSB truncation; posthoc results do not rule out QAT adaptation.

Exponent tie policy is fixed before network evaluation.

The removed mantissa bits are still needed during conversion.

hardware_logic.msb_rule: Eprime=min(3,E+[m2 AND m1 AND NOT m0]); mprime=m0
hardware_logic.rne_rule: keep m2; increment=m1 AND (m0 OR m2); saturate magnitude code to7
hardware_logic.interpretation: Logic description only; no synthesized hardware or bandwidth saving measured.
